title: 第25章 古语凝的请求第26章 都要灭罗家
slug: 我修天道见谁都能一招秒
content_zh:
对于归元宗来说，罗天就是他们的救命恩人。
所以凌虚子这话，也在情理之中。
“罗天公子，贫僧也替夜风国百姓感谢你，来日公子若有差遣，我伏魔寺也绝不推辞！”
元通大师也道谢道。
“还有我！
罗公子，我兄长就是死在这魔头手上，公子替我报了仇，算我欠公子一条命！”
鬼算子也说道。
这几个人，开始争相向罗天示好了。
“这……也不至于吧？”
罗天却有些不好意思。
“罗天公子，这也是诸位前辈的好意，您若拒绝了，他们心里反而不好过。”
古语凝在一旁解释道。
罗天听罢，也不再推辞。
而在这时，凌虚子才转头看向古语凝道：“公主殿下，差点忘了问，您来我归元宗所为何事？”
古语凝顿时脸色一僵，沉吟片刻之后道：“真人，晚辈此来，是来向前辈，向归元宗求援的！”
“求援？”
凌虚子一愣。
古语凝双目含泪，道：“真人，我父皇身患重病，已经卧床半年不起！
朝中奸佞横行，那家伙……已经联合各大世家，随时准备篡夺皇位了！”
“真人，我皇室与归元宗，世代交好，请真人念在往昔情分上，帮我父皇一把！”

说完，她直接跪在了凌虚子面前。
凌虚子立刻起身搀扶，道：“殿下快快请起，这可使不得！
我归元宗与皇室有约，此事我们责无旁贷，只要殿下开口，归元宗自当全力以赴！”
古语凝两眼一亮，道：“多谢真人！”
凌虚子眉头却依然皱着，道：“不过殿下，恕我直言，几十年前我就已经看出那家伙的野心，他本身实力就极为强悍，又筹备了这么多年，只怕光凭我们归元宗的力量，无法撼动他。”
古语凝咬咬牙道：“这我也知道，但我不会放弃！”
凌虚子看着古语凝，朝着罗天的方向使了个眼色。
古语凝愣了一下，瞬间明白过来。
噗通！
她直接跪在了罗天面前。
“罗天公子，在下古语凝，乃是夜风国公主，如今朝中有奸贼篡逆，古语凝斗胆，想请罗天公子，助我清除逆贼！”
然而听完了古语凝的话，罗天却直接站起身来。
“抱歉，没兴趣。”
说完，他转身就走。
罗天想的很清楚。
这种皇室斗争，说白了都是统治阶级内斗，谁胜谁负和自己有什么关系？
总不能因为你古语凝长得好看，我就莫名其妙趟这个浑水吧？
老子又不是舔狗。
没有好处，何必沾染这种因果？
古语凝似乎没有想到，罗天竟然会拒绝自己。
content_en:
For Guiyuan Sect, Luo Tian is their savior.
Therefore, what Ling Xuzi said is reasonable.
"Master Luo Tian, I would also like to thank you on behalf of the people of Yefeng Kingdom. If the master has any mission in the future, I, Fumo Temple, will never refuse!"
Master Yuantong also thanked him.
"And me!
Mr. Luo, my brother died at the hands of this devil. You have avenged me for me. I owe you my life! "
The ghost teller also said.
These people began to rush to show their kindness to Luo Tian.
"This...isn't it?"
Luo Tian was a little embarrassed.
"Master Luo Tian, this is also the good intention of the seniors. If you refuse, they will feel bad."
Gu Yu stood aside and explained.
After hearing this, Luo Tian no longer refused.
At this moment, Ling Xuzi turned to look at Gu Yuning and said, "Your Highness, you almost forgot to ask, why did you come to my Guiyuan Sect?"
Gu Yuning's face suddenly stiffened, and after pondering for a moment, he said: "Master, this junior is here to ask for help from the seniors and the Guiyuan Sect!"
"Ask for help?"
Ling Xuzi was stunned.
Gu Yuning's eyes were filled with tears and he said: "Master, my father is seriously ill and has been bedridden for half a year!
Traitors are rampant in the court, and that guy... has united with the major families and is ready to usurp the throne at any time! "
"Master, my royal family and the Guiyuan Sect have been on good terms for generations. Please remember the past friendship and help my father!"
After saying that, she knelt directly in front of Ling Xuzi.
Ling Xuzi immediately stood up and helped him, saying: "Your Highness, please get up quickly, this is impossible!
I, Gui Yuan Zong, have an appointment with the royal family, and we have no shirk in this matter. As long as His Highness speaks, Gui Yuan Zong will go all out! "
Gu Yuning's eyes lit up and he said, "Thank you so much, Master!"
Ling Xuzi still frowned and said: "But Your Highness, with all due respect, I have seen that guy's ambition decades ago. He is extremely powerful in his own right and has been preparing for so many years. I am afraid that we cannot shake him with the power of our Guiyuan Sect alone."
Gu Yuning gritted her teeth and said, "I know this too, but I won't give up!"
Ling Xuzi looked at Gu Yuning and winked in Luo Tian's direction.
Gu Yuning was stunned for a moment and understood instantly.
Plop!
She knelt directly in front of Luo Tian.
"Master Luo Tian, I am Gu Yuning, the princess of the Night Wind Kingdom. Now there are traitors in the court, and Gu Yuning is bold and wants to ask Master Luo Tian to help me eliminate the traitors!"
However, after listening to Gu Yuning's words, Luo Tian stood up directly.
"Sorry, not interested."
After saying that, he turned around and left.
Luo Tian thought clearly.
This kind of royal struggle is, to put it bluntly, an internal struggle within the ruling class. Who wins and who loses has anything to do with me?
I can't just go into this muddy water just because you look good in Gu Yuning, right?
I'm not a licker.
There is no benefit, so why bother with this kind of karma?
Gu Yuning didn't seem to expect that Luo Tian would reject her.
